&nbsp;Job Position: HR Manager&nbsp;

Job Location: Ota Industrial Estate, Ogun&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time
Sector: Manufacturing
Industry: Flexible Packaging (Polythene Nylon)

Job Summary


	We are currently seeking a smart, organized, and experienced HR Manager for immediate employment.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing administrative operations, supervising staff activities, supporting HR functions, and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations within the organization.
	The candidate must possess strong leadership, people-management, and organizational skills, especially within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Supervise daily administrative and operational activities
	Support recruitment, onboarding, and employee documentation
	Monitor staff attendance, discipline, and workplace coordination
	Maintain employee records and HR documentation
	Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures
	Coordinate office administration and facility management
	Prepare reports, schedules, and operational updates
	Assist management in staff welfare, performance monitoring, and conflict resolution
	Ensure effective communication between management and staff.


Requirements


	Minimum of an OND / HND / B.Sc. Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or related field
	Proven experience in HR and Administration
	Good knowledge of HR processes and administrative operations
	Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
	Ability to multitask and work under pressure
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
	Manufacturing industry experience is an added advantage.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: addozrecruitment@gmail.com using &quot;Human Resources Manager &ndash; Sango-Ota&quot; as the subject of the email.",

  "description": "International Breweries Plc - Our Dream is to bring people together for a better world. Beer, the original social network, has been bringing people together for thousands of years. We are committed to building great brands that stand the test of time and to brewing the best beers using the finest natural ingredients.

Our diverse portfolio of well over 400 beer brands includes global brands Budweiser, Corona and Stella Artois; multi-country brands Beck&rsquo;s, Castle, Castle Lite, Hoegaarden, and Leffe; and local champions such as Aguila, Bud Light, Jupiler, Klinskoye, Modelo Especial, Quilmes, Skol, and Victoria.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job&nbsp;Position: Inventory Clerk&nbsp;

Job Requisition ID:30103412
Job Location: Onitsha, Anambra

Key Purpose


	The Key Purpose of this role is to ensure inventory governance processes and documentation are followed and completed to ensure that any and all physical movement of inventory is correctly reflected in SAP.&nbsp;
	Assist with primary and secondary distribution activities as required.


Key Roles and Responsibilities


	Daily Documentation Control
	Check that all SD shipment packs are correct and complete
	Check that all Interdepot Movement Notes are correct and complete
	Check all PD and SD Gate Registers to physical documents and final load plan
	All stock and shipment packs filed as per SAB requirements
	Assist with credit queries.


Route settlement corrections:


	Process customer and driver corrections as required
	Assign variance reasons to all driver and customer corrections
	Check all RSC invoices have been recorded in register and sent to customers for signature
	Track and resolve missing and unsigned invoices within the specified timeframe


Routine Administration:


	Capture missing broken and foreign survey data
	Print beer age concessions and attach to shipments that are received out of specification
	Capture fuel usage Raise purchase orders
	Ensure all invoice queries are resolved
	Reporting on missing documents and errors found


Governance:


	Ensure that documentation is controlled as per audit and SARBox requirements
	Ensure that inventory management principles and policies are applied


Stock Take Procedures:


	Carry out inventory counts as prescribed in company policies and procedures
	Generate stock variance reports daily
	Issuing and receiving stock
	Assist with issuing and receiving of primary and secondary distribution shipments on SAP when required


Minimum Requirements


	HND / B.Sc in Management-related and Science-related courses
	2-3 years of experience in a Stock Control environment
	Tertiary Higher/Degree in Management Science would be an added advantage

	Sound knowledge of the SAP R3 system.

	Problem-solving ability
	Attention to detail
	Good communication skills
	Good interpersonal skills
	Good verbal ability and communication skills

Inventory Clerk Job at International Breweries Plc




        
    

        
        International Breweries Plc - Our Dream is to bring people together for a better world. Beer, the original social network, has been bringing people together for thousands of years. We are committed to building great brands that stand the test of time and to brewing the best beers using the finest natural ingredients.

Our diverse portfolio of well over 400 beer brands includes global brands Budweiser, Corona and Stella Artois; multi-country brands Beck’s, Castle, Castle Lite, Hoegaarden, and Leffe; and local champions such as Aguila, Bud Light, Jupiler, Klinskoye, Modelo Especial, Quilmes, Skol, and Victoria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Inventory Clerk 
     

            
    



Job Requisition ID:30103412
Job Location: Onitsha, Anambra

Key Purpose


	The Key Purpose of this role is to ensure inventory governance processes and documentation are followed and completed to ensure that any and all physical movement of inventory is correctly reflected in SAP. 
	Assist with primary and secondary distribution activities as required.


Key Roles and Responsibilities


	Daily Documentation Control
	Check that all SD shipment packs are correct and complete
	Check that all Interdepot Movement Notes are correct and complete
	Check all PD and SD Gate Registers to physical documents and final load plan
	All stock and shipment packs filed as per SAB requirements
	Assist with credit queries.


Route settlement corrections:


	Process customer and driver corrections as required
	Assign variance reasons to all driver and customer corrections
	Check all RSC invoices have been recorded in register and sent to customers for signature
	Track and resolve missing and unsigned invoices within the specified timeframe


Routine Administration:


	Capture missing broken and foreign survey data
	Print beer age concessions and attach to shipments that are received out of specification
	Capture fuel usage Raise purchase orders
	Ensure all invoice queries are resolved
	Reporting on missing documents and errors found


Governance:


	Ensure that documentation is controlled as per audit and SARBox requirements
	Ensure that inventory management principles and policies are applied


Stock Take Procedures:


	Carry out inventory counts as prescribed in company policies and procedures
	Generate stock variance reports daily
	Issuing and receiving stock
	Assist with issuing and receiving of primary and secondary distribution shipments on SAP when required


Minimum Requirements


	HND / B.Sc in Management-related and Science-related courses
	2-3 years of experience in a Stock Control environment
	Tertiary Higher/Degree in Management Science would be an added advantage
	Excellent knowledge of Stock Control processes
	Good MS Office proficiency
	Sound knowledge of the SAP R3 system.


Key Attributes and Competencies:


	Problem-solving ability
	Attention to detail
	Good communication skills
	Good interpersonal skills
	Good verbal ability and communication skills
	Ability to manage self
	Good team player
	Ability to work independently
	Good customer ethics and interpersonal skills.
